reusable_lessons.lesson: When testing uniqueness of natural keys and candidate keys, include both single-column and composite-key candidates. For instance, when adherence data may have a natural key as either (member_id) alone or (member_id + therapeutic_class) as a composite, test both to determine which is the true natural key.

current_task_corrections.correction: Set the missingness scope parameter to 'all_columns' instead of 'top_10' to ensure that entirely empty and near-empty columns are included in the profile.

Add 'adherence.member_id' to the duplicate_check keys list. The complete set of keys to test should include all natural keys: 'medical_claims.claim_id', 'pharmacy_claims.rx_claim_id', 'members.member_id', 'providers.provider_npi', 'adherence.member_id', and 'adherence.member_id+therapeutic_class'.
